root_cause_label: Undertrained Word2Vec with Only 3 Epochs and High Residual Loss Produces Embeddings that Fail Analogy Quality Requirements
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent chose an insufficient training configuration (3 epochs, Adam optimizer, still-high loss ~4076) and then accepted the resulting embeddings without retraining despite observing that key analogies like man:woman::king->queen and paris:france::london->england failed, ultimately claiming success with semantically weak embeddings.
t_err_evidence: creates word2vec.py saving full model state dict (both embedding matrices), causing 66MB file
t_commit_evidence: Step 16: Training completes successfully with average loss still ~4076 (down from ~4447 at epoch 1), and the model/vocab are saved. The agent does not recognize the still-high loss as a signal to retrain with more epochs; instead it proceeds to artifact optimization, locking in the poor-quality embeddings.
t_surface_evidence: optimize_model.py shows original model size 65.4 MB, confirming oversized artifact
trigger_explanation: At step 10, the agent committed to writing a training script with only 3 epochs without first verifying whether that configuration would produce embeddings of sufficient quality for analogy tasks. The decision was made based on general knowledge (skip-gram is good for analogies) without any empirical check of convergence requirements for this corpus size, constituting premature commitment to an undertrained configuration.
